description: Defines the net::HttpCache::Writers class, which manages synchronized access to network response data for multiple HttpCache::Transactions, including transaction management, network reads, cache writing, and state handling.

classes.name: net::HttpCache::Writers
classes.description: Manages multiple HttpCache::Transaction instances accessing the same cache entry, handling network reads, cache writes, transaction addition/removal, and state transitions.

classes.name: net::HttpCache::Writers::TransactionInfo
classes.description: Stores per-transaction information such as partial data, truncation status, and response info.

classes.name: net::HttpCache::Writers::WaitingForRead
classes.description: Represents a transaction waiting for a network read to complete, including buffer, length, callback, and write progress.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Retrieves data from the network transaction, either directly or by copying from another transaction, possibly asynchronously.

methods.name: StopCaching
methods.description: Stops caching if no other transactions are active, optionally preserving the cache entry.

methods.name: AddTransaction
methods.description: Adds a transaction to the Writers set with initial writing pattern, priority, and transaction info.

methods.name: RemoveTransaction
methods.description: Removes a transaction from the Writers set, indicating completion.

methods.name: UpdatePriority
methods.description: Updates the priority of the set based on individual transaction priorities.

methods.name: CanAddWriters
methods.description: Checks if more transactions can be added for shared writing, providing reason if not.

methods.name: SetNetworkTransaction
methods.description: Associates a network transaction with the Writers, optionally validating checksum.

methods.name: ResetNetworkTransaction
methods.description: Resets the network transaction, used for range requests.
